data.content_ref: inline:The relation is conditional and speculative: it asserts a contradiction only 'if' SRC_003 reports 'a clean or passing verification,' but never establishes that SRC_003 actually does so. As stated, the contradiction may not exist at all — if SRC_003's metrics are neutral or partial, there is no relation. The refutation clause then merely restates this same condition in the negative (refuted if SRC_003 reports the same masking phenomenon), so the artifact names a possible contradiction between two records without committing to whether either endpoint actually contains the content needed for that contradiction to hold.
